admission.justification: A future performance cut must not silently omit file entries from marks classification or read every file eagerly before a view requests its marks.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer classification-scope boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: For a listed changed path with a comparison, an active marks view obtains the shared per-file classification unless supplied by its caller; failed reads may be retried and late reads cannot draw another path/scope.
exclusions: No obligation to read marks for unchanged or unlisted paths, no unconditional single network request across failures/scopes, and no bound on every response size or a semantic grade.
statement: Per-file classification includes every entry of the requested file and is read when a view drawing that file's marks opens.
